key_finding.summary: Under matched FAR budgets on identical targets, Random Forest can match or beat the CNN-LSTM false-alarm count at tight budgets (0.001 and 0.0005) while both achieve FNR=0 on this ICMP-Flood vs Benign pilot subset.
key_finding.caveat: Pilot uses Hugging Face raw CICIoT files with filename labels, not the private Google Drive prepared split from the thesis notebook. Attack class limited to ICMP Flood files. CPU 2-epoch CNN-LSTM pilot.

required_inputs_resolved: HF CICIoT Benign + ICMP Flood CSVs
